title: Transcription reconciliation record
scope: All 28 supplied photographs compared against the alternate transcription; substantive differences reviewed against local source images. This is an audit, not a claim of perfect decipherment.
method: Image evidence determines text. Historical matches are separate context and do not erase source spelling, crossed-out text or unresolved readings. Changes marked tentative retain bracketed uncertainty in both copies.
